name: seatd
title: seatd-0.9.3
summary: The seatd package provides a universal seat management library. It is what a lot of Wayland compositors use to manage seats, a session for a user in which applications can interact with. It can optionally provide its own seat manager as an alternative to a logind variant, but the instructions provided will use it as a shim, which logind from Systemd-261.2 will be the underlying seat manager.
